name: reference
assumptions: Seed rows sourced from committed forge pins (smartcontracts/evm/test/vectors/plus_zero_gas.json, written by test/governance/PlusZero.t.sol), until the SDK gas generator writes this file.
Foundry 1.8.5, foundry.toml: evm_version amsterdam, isolate = true (each top-level call its own transaction), bytecode_hash none.
gas is execution gas without the intrinsic 21,000 and calldata (the SDK adds both and its margin); every pin measured with entryRef = 0 on a lane used before (not fresh).
Rows with stand_in rely on a stand-in verifier or a mocked precompile and may undershoot on a real chain.

rows.stand_in: P-256 (0x0101) verified by the fixture's stand-in verifier
mldsa65 (0x0131) verified through a mocked precompile candidate
